purpose: Makongi FC football club management web app: public club site with squad, starting XI and formations, fixtures and results, player statistics, league table, matchday and birthday posters, club news, and a secure admin dashboard for managing the club.

features.name: Brand, home page and public club site
features.description: Makongi FC visual identity, responsive shell, home page with next-match countdown, latest result, league snapshot, season stats, featured players, news and fixture previews.
features.evidence: 2026-10-26: node .\scripts\verify.mjs — all 9 public views rendered; HTTP / returned 200. Home renders 36,681 characters in the DOM smoke test. Live at https://football-club-022114646468401970169.vercel.app (HTTP 200).
done_criteria: Home page uses seeded club data

features.name: Squad, player profiles and starting XI
features.description: 24-player squad with filters and generated/uploaded portraits, individual profiles, three formations, pitch view, substitutes, coach and XI summary.
features.evidence: 2026-10-26: verify suite checks 24 unique players, three 11-player lineups and 7-player benches; squad and lineup views render.
done_criteria: Squad data is unique and complete

features.name: Fixtures, results, statistics, league table and news
features.description: Upcoming fixtures, finished results with scores and scorers, sortable player statistics, 10-club league table with form, and filterable club news with full article reader.
features.evidence: 2026-10-26: verify suite confirms 13 fixtures, 8 results matching a 6W-2D-0L record, 16 player goals matching 16 team goals, 10 clubs and 6 news articles.

features.name: Matchday and birthday poster studio
features.description: Canvas-generated 1080x1350 matchday and birthday posters with Makongi crest, red/black themes, editable fixture/player details, PNG download and copyable caption.
features.evidence: 2026-10-26: poster view rendered; poster caption helper and SVG portrait generation covered by the verify suite.
done_criteria: PNG export works in the browser

features.name: Secure-demo admin dashboard
features.description: Hashed-password login with session timeout and lockout, player CRUD with photo compression, fixture/result CRUD, news CRUD, lineup builder and club information editor on localStorage.
features.evidence: 2026-10-26: verify suite matches the documented password to the SHA-256 hash and renders all six admin tabs; demo login and reset are wired.
done_criteria: Login works with documented demo credentials
Edits persist and can be reset

features.name: Production database, auth and media storage
features.description: Replace localStorage and browser-side demo authentication with PostgreSQL/Supabase, server-side sessions and roles, cloud image storage and an audit trail.
features.evidence: Not started. The prototype is browser-only and clearly labels its demo limits.
done_criteria: Server API and database migrations exist
Server-side auth and roles protect admin routes
